traderLens.name: Minervini
traderLens.view: Market structure is highly bifurcated. Focus strictly on Stage 2 market leaders with high RS (XLK, CIBR) breaking out of legitimate VCP bases (e.g., UTHR, ROG). Do not chase extended indexes.

traderLens.name: Ted Zhang
traderLens.view: Institutional flow is heavily concentrated in enterprise tech, cloud software, and select defense names (BA). Cyclicals and interest rate proxies are seeing distribution.

traderLens.name: Clement Ang
traderLens.view: Market context is mixed: megacap tech is A-grade, but broad market participation is weak (fear at 34/100, 41.8% >200SMA). Demand flawless setups before committing capital.

traderLens.name: SRxTrades
traderLens.view: Reclaim setups like NVDA and AAPL offer well-defined pivot risk. Avoid buying breakouts in names with thin or unconfirmed volume.

traderLens.name: Jeff
traderLens.view: Do not let quarter-end volatility shake discipline. Use hard stops on every position and trim into strength on extended names.

traderLens.name: Qullamaggie
traderLens.view: A few strong momentum episodic pivots in biotech and software. Use Opening Range High (ORH) as your entry trigger with Low of Day (LOD) stops.

traderLens.name: Composite
traderLens.view: Maintain posture at WAIT for broad market additions while operating selectively on high-conviction leader pullbacks (NVDA, AAPL) and clear Stage 2 VCP breakouts (UTHR).
